an4.190:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati pubbārāme migāramātupāsāde.
an4.190:1.2: tena kho pana samayena bhagavā tadahuposathe bhikkhusaṅghaparivuto nisinno hoti.
an4.190:1.3: atha kho bhagavā tuṇhībhūtaṃ tuṇhībhūtaṃ bhikkhusaṅghaṃ anuviloketvā bhikkhū āmantesi :
an4.190:2.1: apalāpāyaṃ bhikkhave parisā. nippalāpāyaṃ bhikkhave parisā suddhā sāre patiṭṭhitā.
an4.190:2.2: tathārūpo ayaṃ bhikkhave bhikkhusaṅgho. tathārūpāyaṃ bhikkhave parisā
an4.190:2.3: yathārūpā parisā dullabhā dassanāyapi lokasmiṃ. tathārūpo ayaṃ bhikkhave bhikkhusaṅgho. tathārūpāyaṃ bhikkhave parisā
an4.190:2.4: āhuneyyā pāhuneyyā dakkhiṇeyyā añjalikaraṇīyā anuttaraṃ puññakkhettaṃ lokassa. tathārūpo ayaṃ bhikkhave bhikkhusaṅgho tathārūpāyaṃ bhikkhave parisā
an4.190:2.5: yathārūpāya parisā appampi dinnaṃ bahuṃ hoti, bahuṃ dinnaṃ bahutaraṃ. tathārūpo ayaṃ bhikkhave bhikkhusaṅgho. tathārūpāyaṃ bhikkhave parisā
an4.190:2.6: yathārūpaṃ parisaṃ alaṃ yojanagaṇanānipi dassanāya gantuṃ apipuṭaṃsenāpi. tathārūpo ayaṃ bhikkhave bhikkhusaṅgho.
an4.190:3.1: santi bhikkhave bhikkhū imasmiṃ bhikkhusaṅghe devappattā viharanti.
an4.190:3.2: santi bhikkhave bhikkhū imasmiṃ bhikkhusaṅghe brahmappattā viharanti.
an4.190:3.3: santi bhikkhave bhikkhū imasmiṃ bhikkhusaṅghe āneñjappattā viharanti.
an4.190:3.4: santi bhikkhave bhikkhū imasmiṃ bhikkhusaṅghe ariyappattā viharanti.
an4.190:4.1: kathaṃ ca bhikkhave bhikkhu devappatto hoti?
an4.190:4.2: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu vivicceva kāmehi …pe… paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
an4.190:4.3: …pe… dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ …pe… tatiyaṃ jhānaṃ …pe… catutthaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
an4.190:4.4: evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu devappatto hoti.
an4.190:5.1: kathaṃ ca bhikkhave bhikkhu brahmappatto hoti?
an4.190:5.2: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu mettāsahagatena cetasā ekaṃ disaṃ pharitvā viharati. tathā dutiyaṃ …pe… tathā tatiyaṃ …pe… tathā catutthiṃ. iti uddhamadho tiriyaṃ sabbadhi sabbattatāya sabbāvantaṃ lokaṃ mettāsahagatena cetasā vipulena mahaggatena appamāṇena averena abyāpajjena pharitvā viharati.
an4.190:5.5: upekkhāsahagatena cetasā ekaṃ disaṃ pharitvā viharati. tathā dutiyaṃ …pe… tathā tatiyaṃ …pe… tathā catutthiṃ …pe… iti uddhamadho tiriyaṃ sabbadhi sabbattatāya sabbāvantaṃ lokaṃ upekkhāsahagatena cetasā vipulena mahaggatena appamāṇena averena abyāpajjena pharitvā viharati.
an4.190:5.6: evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu brahmappatto hoti.
an4.190:6.1: kathaṃ ca bhikkhave bhikkhu āneñjappatto hoti?
an4.190:6.2: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu sabbaso rūpasaññānaṃ samatikkamā paṭighasaññānaṃ atthagamā nānattasaññānaṃ amanasikārā ananto ākāsoti ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati.
an4.190:6.3: sabbaso ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ samatikkamma anantaṃ viññāṇanti viññāṇañcāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati.
an4.190:6.4: sabbaso viññāṇañcāyatanaṃ samatikkamma natthi kiñcīti ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati.
an4.190:6.5: sabbaso ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ samatikkamma nevasaññānāsaññāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati.
an4.190:6.6: evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu āneñjappatto hoti.
an4.190:7.1: kathaṃ ca bhikkhave bhikkhu ariyappatto hoti?
an4.190:7.2: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu idaṃ dukkhanti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti. ayaṃ dukkhasamudayoti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti. ayaṃ dukkhanirodhoti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti. ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadāti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti.
an4.190:7.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu ariyappatto hotīti.
